goal: Build a small to-do list tool as a Python package named todo, run as python3 -m todo --file PATH COMMAND. Storage: a JSON file at PATH holding a list of items {"id": int, "text": str, "done": bool}; a missing file means an empty list; ids start at 1 and are never reused, even after removal (store the next id in the file). Commands: add TEXT prints the new id; list prints one line per item as '<id> [ ] text' or '<id> [x] text' in id order, and with --pending only items not done; done ID marks an item done; remove ID deletes it; done or remove of an unknown id prints an error to stderr and exits with status 2. Keep storage, command logic and the command line in separate modules (todo/store.py, todo/core.py, todo/__main__.py). Include a pytest suite for each module.
constraints: Write the JSON file atomically: write a temp file, then rename it
